title: Gmail
intro: Let your agents read Gmail, your primary Google Calendar, and Google Tasks. If you allow it, they can save drafts, send email, and create or change events and tasks under your chosen write mode.
limits: Select Connect with Google to add a connection and sign in to your Google account. Gmail labels limit mail access only; the connection can read your primary calendar and task lists. An agent uses the connection only when you ask in a chat.
name: Name
labelsHelp: One Gmail label name or ID per line. Write a name with spaces with dashes. {{count}} listed. The agent reaches only mail that has one of these labels. Write ALL to give the whole mailbox.
labelsShape: "{{entry}}" is not a label. Use the name or the ID of a label, or ALL.
allNote: ALL gives the agent every mail this account can read, in every label, including mail that you never meant a model to see. Calendar and Tasks access is separate from this label restriction.
agentOptionalHint: Optional. Without an agent this connection only holds the login, the label list and the write mode for your chats. It answers no messages and listens for nothing.
empty: No Gmail connections yet. Select Connect with Google to add one.
noLabels: No labels listed: the agent can read nothing.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: The agent can no longer reach this mailbox. LocalAI asks Google to revoke the login, then forgets it.

setup.title: How to choose labels
setup.step1: Write the name of a Gmail label, for example Work, or a system label such as INBOX or STARRED. A name with spaces is written with dashes.
setup.step2: The agent reaches only mail that has the label. Spam and trash are never searched. Calendar and Tasks access is not limited by Gmail labels.
setup.step3: The write mode below also needs the optional access to be allowed when you connect. Without it the agent can only read.

writeMode.label: What the agent may change
writeMode.hint: Save and send Gmail drafts, and create, update, complete, or delete Calendar events and Tasks. It does not change settings.

line.off: It cannot change Gmail, Calendar, or Tasks.
line.propose: Each change waits for your OK.
line.auto: Your chats can make changes at once.

note.off: Write access is off: this connection only reads Gmail, Calendar, and Tasks.
note.propose: Each email, event, or task change waits in your approvals until you confirm it. You see the proposed change first. It also needs the optional write scopes you allow when you connect.
note.auto: Your chats can change Gmail, Calendar, and Tasks at once, without asking. Sending an email cannot be taken back. Runs without you present still wait for your confirmation. This also needs the optional write scopes you allow when you connect.

approval.title: Title
approval.changeNote: This Google Calendar or Tasks change will be made when you confirm it.
approval.deleteNote: This Google Calendar or Tasks item will be deleted when you confirm it.
approval.subject: Subject
approval.cut: The text shown here is cut. The full text, {{bytes}} bytes, is saved.
approval.draftNote: This saves a draft in your Gmail. It does not send it.
approval.sendNote: This sends an e-mail from your Gmail to the people above. A sent e-mail cannot be taken back.
